name: Death Valley National Park
tagline: Death Valley — short cool-season stops only; heat is the limit.

practical.energy_note: HEAT KILLS — winter/spring only for most families; gallons of water.
practical.best_start: Visitor center → one overlook → short badlands path if cool
practical.season_note: Summer often unsafe for outdoor walking.
